name: analog
title: Analog artifact detector
description: Tape-era artifact scan for digitised analog video: dropout streaks, VHS head-switching noise, time-base (TBC) line wobble, AGC/film luma flicker. Timeline marks + 'analog' QC profile + analyze.py pass.

name: captions
title: Captions QC
description: Subtitle/caption compliance: track discovery (text/bitmap/CC), speech coverage, systematic sync offset vs speech onsets, reading speed (CPS), overlaps and layout. 'captions' QC profile + analyze.py pass writing <name>.captions.txt.

name: ocr
title: Timer / timecode OCR
description: Burned-in timer audit: calibrate the overlay font once (no OCR engine needed), then read it on every frame - backward jumps and skips (splice evidence), freezes, and clock-drift slope (slowed/sped-up footage). LiveSplit, in-game timers, SMPTE burn-ins, CCTV timestamps.

name: speedrun
title: Speedrun forensics
description: Run-verification workbench: Verify run (platform/tempo screens + forensic verdicts), speedrun QC profile, frame-accurate retimer with mod notes, load remover / load-removed time, music-bed continuity scan, RNG luck calculator.

name: steg
title: Hidden-data / steganography scan
description: Detect data hidden in a video file: container forensics (appended data, polyglot archives, stuffed padding atoms, unreferenced mdat, entropy map), pixel-LSB steganalysis (RS + chi-square, gated to lossless sources), and compressed-domain indicators (SEI user-data NAL scan, frame-size-vs-complexity residual). 'steg' QC profile + analyze.py pass writing <name>.steg.txt.
